limitations: Manager CIK identifies the filer, not any held issuer/security. No company or ticker/name join is made.
Pairs are selected by exact manager/report-period and explicit filing flags, not a verified predecessor accession, supersession or complete amendment chain.

Thirteen raw INFO text fields are compared exactly as a multiset, excluding only accession and source key. No normalization, numeric difference, economic position/security matching or trading-flow interpretation occurs.

Duplicate multiplicity is preserved. Matched rows are identical source records, not independently verified identical economic positions; unmatched rows may reflect any textual, classification, numeric or other source difference.

Blank confidentiality flags mean unknown, not N. Even two explicit N flags do not prove complete holdings; confidential positions, omission rules and original disclosures are not independently resolved.
Filing date and report period remain distinct. Retrospective local verification is not first-public or decision-time evidence. Historical reports are not current ownership.
Missing INFO source rows are not a verified zero portfolio. Summary row counts are diagnostics, not a guarantee of completeness; mismatches do not silently exclude a pair.
Original filing lookup links are constructed/unfetched; the pinned prepared archive is the verified citation. Raw positions, names, identifiers, shares, values and matching lineage remain private.
All candidate exclusions are preserved. The32eligiblepairs are not all amendments, all managers or a representative sample. No sums across periods, forecasts, rankings or orders are produced.

policy.candidate: Exactly two submissions; one13F-HR with cover ISAMENDMENT=N and one13F-HR/A with Y, RESTATEMENT and AMENDMENTNO=1
eligibility: Original filing date strictly earlier than amendment
policy.inventory: Exact pinned June-August2026 prepared13F archive only
policy.matching: Exact multiset of13 INFOTABLE raw text fields excluding accession and SK only; no normalization or numeric comparison
